from PIL import Image
import numpy as np, cv2
im=cv2.imread('first_frame.png'); hsv=cv2.cvtColor(im,cv2.COLOR_BGR2HSV); H,S,V=cv2.split(hsv)
# components various likely masks
masks={
'orange':((H<28)&(S>80)&(V>80)),
'orange_strong':((H<22)&(S>130)&(V>120)),
'skin':((H<25)&(S>25)&(S<180)&(V>75)),
'brightgray':((S<40)&(V>130)),
'dark':V<60,
}
for name,m in masks.items():
 u=(m.astype(np.uint8)*255)
 n,lab,stats,cen=cv2.connectedComponentsWithStats(u,8)
 comps=sorted([(stats[i,4], tuple(stats[i,:4]), tuple(np.round(cen[i],1))) for i in range(1,n)],reverse=True)[:15]
 print('\\n',name,'count',int(m.sum()))
 print(*comps,sep='\\n')
# Hough line edges, central
G=cv2.cvtColor(im,cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY)
E=cv2.Canny(G,40,100)
lines=cv2.HoughLinesP(E,1,np.pi/180,threshold=80,minLineLength=80,maxLineGap=15)
arr=[]
for l in lines[:,0] if lines is not None else []:
 x1,y1,x2,y2=map(int,l); L=np.hypot(x2-x1,y2-y1); ang=np.degrees(np.arctan2(y2-y1,x2-x1))
 arr.append((round(L,1),round(ang,1),(x1,y1,x2,y2)))
print('\\nLINES')
for x in sorted(arr,reverse=True)[:100]: print(x)
# saturation + hsv samples grids around center, every 40 report most sat color/location
print('\\nROW strong orange ranges')
m=masks['orange_strong']
for y0 in range(0,720,20):
 xs=np.where(m[y0:y0+20].any(axis=0))[0]
 if len(xs):
  # contiguous
  gr=[]; st=pr=xs[0]
  for x in xs[1:]:
   if x>pr+1: gr.append((st,pr));st=x
   pr=x
  gr.append((st,pr))
  if any(b-a>3 for a,b in gr): print(y0,[(a,b) for a,b in gr if b-a>3])

import cv2,numpy as np
im=cv2.imread('first_frame.png'); rgb=im[:,:,::-1]
# kmeans global colors
p=rgb.reshape(-1,3).astype(np.float32)
crit=(cv2.TERM_CRITERIA_EPS+cv2.TERM_CRITERIA_MAX_ITER,30,.2)
_,lab,cen=cv2.kmeans(p,12,None,crit,5,cv2.KMEANS_PP_CENTERS)

# sort manually chars by cluster, downsample nearest cluster mode for crop
chars='0123456789AB'
L=lab.reshape(720,1280)
for y0,y1,x0,x1,s in [(80,600,250,1000,10),(140,500,430,820,5),(0,720,0,1280,20)]:

 for y in range(y0,y1,s):
  st=''
  for x in range(x0,x1,s):
   a=L[y:min(y+s,y1),x:min(x+s,x1)]
   bc=np.bincount(a.ravel(),minlength=12)
   st+=chars[bc.argmax()]
  print(st)
